title: Report (PDF)
description: The report “One-loop renormalisation of the Standard Model in the unbroken phase with a non-anticommuting gamma5” (PDF, 186 pages).

title: Report headings and pages
description: First page of every labelled heading of the report, used for the page references of this site.

title: Model specification (TOML)
description: Input of the automation: gauge group, chiral multiplets, scalar doublet, classical four-dimensional Lagrangian, gauge fixing and regularisation of the one-family Standard Model.
group: Automation: model specification and run outputs

title: Comparison with the report
description: Comparison of the run with the report's final numbers, quantity by quantity.
group: Automation: model specification and run outputs

title: Run report (JSON)
description: Every step, check and result of the run: graph counts per class, renormalisation constants, beta functions, breaking and restoring coefficients.
group: Automation: model specification and run outputs

title: Run report (text)
description: Readable summary of the run report: steps with timings, the fifteen checks and the results of order one.
group: Automation: model specification and run outputs

title: Order data
description: Matched loop data of order one as exact local functionals: the pole coefficients and the finite breaking.
group: Automation: model specification and run outputs

title: Renormalised model (HepKIT JSON)
description: The renormalised model: classical action, breaking, singular and finite restoring counterterms and their breaking insertions, as a HepKIT model.
group: Automation: model specification and run outputs

title: Order store
description: Exact order store of the run (all functionals of order one), the input of the next loop order.
group: Automation: model specification and run outputs

title: Tree-level model (HepKIT JSON)
description: Regularised classical action with ghosts, sources and the breaking insertion, in the Feynman gauge, as a HepKIT model.
group: Automation: model specification and run outputs

title: Final counterterms
description: The report's final numbers: singular counterterm, finite breaking, restoring coefficients and literature comparison.

title: g0_FF: final result
description: Final numbers of the class g0_FF, Fermion two-point functions Ψ̄Ψ (Section 4.1.4): graphs, loop functions, local operators, checks and caveats of the two independent calculations.

title: Assembly of the singular counterterm
description: Over-determined assembly of the singular counterterm from the eighteen classes: monomial coefficients, renormalisation constants, beta functions and evanescent part.
group: Assembly and checks of the report

title: Pole identity
description: Check of the pole identity for the Green's functions with one breaking insertion, leg assignment by leg assignment.
group: Assembly and checks of the report

title: Restoring counterterm (engine solution)
description: Solution of the restoring condition with the plane-wave engine: the finite breaking by class and the restoring coefficients.
group: Assembly and checks of the report

title: Restoring counterterm (hand solution)
description: Independent hand solution of the restoring condition under the normalisation conditions.
group: Assembly and checks of the report

title: Graph enumeration summary
description: Counts of the one-loop one-particle-irreducible graphs per class and their comparison with hand counts.
group: Hand-written HepKIT model of the report

title: Notes on the hand-written model

description: Hand-written HepKIT JSON model of the regularised unbroken Standard Model with sterile partners, used for the report's graph enumeration.

title: HepKIT model with true ghost numbers
description: Variant of the hand-written model with anticommuting (native) ghosts.
